scope: One ordinary strong simple baseline probe on reused development workload. Not novel method, independent confirmation, Andes reproduction or same-state counterfactual performance.

research_question: Does ordinary longest already-exposed output stall improve full-request maxgap tradeoffs relative to arrival-age in the same native legal recovery set?
only_changed_factor: Sort current legal candidates by last actual past client output versus arrival; both select first then unchanged per-episode and total8 guards.
decision: If stall improves full maxgap tradeoff with disclosed costs, keep as strong ordinary baseline and withdraw generic service-age novelty. If concentration transfers waiting and hurts overall target, stop stall rule, no budget/threshold scan. Mixed/noisy effects remain uncertain, not a reason for complex predictor.
